articles.name: Configuring top-level administrator accounts
articles.title: Configuring top-level administrator accounts
articles.body:
Who holds top-level administrator access

Paramify workspaces have one top-level administrator role, the Workspace Owner. Request access through your Paramify account team.

Configure

  1. Configure SSO and require MFA for every administrator.
  2. Limit the number of Workspace Owners to two.

Operate

Operate day to day with a non-administrator account, and review the audit log monthly.

Decommission

To decommission a top-level administrator account, transfer ownership first, then remove the user.

Last updated: September 30, 2026
